part.name: Countertop espresso machine assembly
part.description: A multi-solid countertop espresso machine comprising an enclosing chassis, cup-warming and perforated panels, user controls, a central brewing head, a projecting service wand, lever components, and two cup-like accessories. CadQuery reports 56 disconnected solids; these are interpreted as separate functional and decorative assembly components rather than accidental disconnected geometry.
part.symmetry_note: The principal enclosure is approximately bilaterally symmetric about the machine center plane. The central brewing and control elements are approximately centered, while the service wand and several small controls break symmetry. Repeated structures include four corner feet, twenty parallel warming-tray ribs, approximately 108 panel recesses, four control detents, and two elongated control slots.

semantic_orientation.description: The human-semantic front is the operating side containing the control dial, brewing head, cup bay, and service wand. The top contains the ribbed cup-warming tray. Camera labels are treated as view directions rather than object-side names.
